en: Colorized historical street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European buildings, shops, and awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks; a horse‑drawn cart and an early tram or carriage travel down the street. Gas‑style street lamps stand along the road. At the top of the image in red text is the caption identifying the view. A large sign on one building advertises a pharmacy in German.
